_comment: Prerendered SDXL cover-art catalog. Built by _tools/catalog_build.py on a GPU machine; a curated subset ships, the full set fetches on demand. cover_pick.py scores entries against a book's intent (mood/tags/palette) and, when no strong match exists, falls back to hypergen (which renders anywhere). An empty entries[] is fully valid -- hypergen alone gives every machine a cover.

entry_schema.description: a single lit window in a dark facade, painterly, moody
